description:
Delete a service integration. This removes the connection between the source and destination services.

For `application_service_credential`, this removes the source service → destination application service integration. Use list/get to verify `service_integration_id`, `source_service`, and `dest_service` first.

**Warning:** Deleting an integration may disrupt application access, metrics, logs, replication, or other data flows. Confirm with the user before proceeding. The MCP schema currently describes `application_service_credential` in detail. Aiven supports other integration types too.
name: aiven_service_integration_delete
title: Service Integration Delete
